dict.string: RCQ uses Bluetooth to discover and chat with people physically nearby — no internet required. Direction-finding is off; data stays on the local radio link.
RCQ needs the camera for video calls and to take photos and videos to share in chats.
RCQ can use Face ID to unlock the app instead of typing your Security PIN.
Radio Chat needs the local network to discover other RCQ users on the same Bluetooth/Wi-Fi mesh. Nothing leaves your device through the internet on this surface.
Your location is used only to find other RCQ users near you while People Nearby is on. Your exact coordinates stay on this device — only a coarse area tag is shared.
RCQ needs the microphone for voice and video calls.
RCQ saves photos you choose to download from a chat into your camera roll.
RCQ needs access to your photos and videos so you can attach them to a chat message.
